_comment: Hand-authored metadata that cannot be inferred automatically from pixel data alone (animation rows, tile grid size). Keyed by generated asset id. Merged onto the auto-discovered manifest entry by scripts/generate-assets.mjs. Frame layout was determined by visual inspection of the Cute Fantasy sprite sheets. Asset ids mirror the folder layout under assets/cute-fantasy-rpg/: tilesets/, characters/{player,enemies,animals}/, props/{buildings/}, animations/, ui/.

characters/player/player._comment: This sheet only has 6 real movement rows (0-5) — verified by visually inspecting every row/frame (see docs/Architecture.md 'Sprite sheet notes'). Rows 6-8 are attack/action poses (sword frames) and row 9 is a faint/death pose, not walk cycles. There is no dedicated right-facing row: right movement is idle-left/walk-left played with the sprite horizontally flipped (see AnimatedActor.playAnim).

props/buildings/church-red-front._comment: Cropped from Church_Red.png's 4-frame sheet (Cute Fantasy premium pack) — one 112x144 frame with the door and unlit windows, matching the daytime look of every other building.

props/buildings/greenhouse-wood-front._comment: Cropped from GreenHouse_Wood.png's 4-frame sheet (Cute Fantasy premium pack) — the front-facing frame with a visible door.

animations/lillypad-green-anim._comment: Cute Fantasy premium pack, 8-frame horizontal strip — a lilypad gently bobbing on the water.

animations/cattail-anim._comment: Cute Fantasy premium pack, 8-frame horizontal strip — reeds swaying at the pond's edge.

animations/grass-sway-anim._comment: Cute Fantasy premium pack, 8-frame horizontal strip — a grass tuft swaying in the breeze.

ui/resources-icons-outline._comment: Cute Fantasy premium pack, 6x6 grid of resource icons. Staged for future in-game UI use, not yet drawn anywhere.

ui/tool-icons-outline._comment: Cute Fantasy premium pack, 10x1 strip of tool icons. Staged for future in-game UI use, not yet drawn anywhere.

characters/animals/chicken/chicken._comment: This file is actually a 2x2 grid of 4 poses, not a single sprite — confirmed by visual inspection when first wiring an animal into a scene. Use chicken-idle (cropped single frame) instead of this one for in-world rendering.

characters/animals/chicken/chicken-idle._comment: Top-left frame cropped from chicken.png's 2x2 pose grid.
